sources.title: Multimodal Electric Guitar Data
sources.gradient_scope: product-family-presence-positive-only-fit-low-weight; blocked from restoration and all-zero Clean supervision
sources.pairing: line-input recordings from a fixed Roland guitar amplifier; repository-owned effects are rendered ephemerally and only labels for added effects receive gradients
sources.control_labels: participant, playing task, dynamics and free improvisation; no effect controls
audio_quality_caveats: the archive has p01-p32 folders while the paper identifies 31 complete participants; player diversity claims remain capped at 31
31 trained guitarists are valuable for player diversity, but all used the study instrument and one controlled laboratory chain
the official paper states that audio was recorded as line input from a Roland guitar amplifier through a Universal Audio Apollo Twin

amplifier model, controls and built-in effect settings are not documented; three Range-audited samples showed no obvious delay repeats or modulation tracks, which is not proof that the amplifier was effect-free
amplifier coloration is embedded, so this is never a raw pickup DI or a restoration target
positive-only target masks prevent undocumented baseline coloration from becoming false negative effect labels
five files with clipping or near-silent level are retained as evidence but excluded from sampling
the related paper is CC-BY-NC-4.0, while the dataset itself is independently CC-BY-4.0 on the official Zenodo API

sources.title: rusty-amp no-cabinet Marshall stage renderer
sources.pairing: pinned offline renderer exposes eight deterministic Marshall no-cabinet boundaries from admitted Clean DI: front end, preamp, tone stack, voice balance, power amp, output transformer, speaker load and final output
sources.control_labels: known gain, bass, mid, treble, presence and master controls, all normalized 0..1

artifact_audit.source_tests: 181 library tests passed on macOS arm64 with Rust 1.96.0
artifact_audit.tap_probe: all eight 44.1-kHz float32 stage files were finite, frame-aligned and had distinct SHA-256 values
artifact_audit.cabinet_policy: built-in and external cabinet paths are excluded

audio_quality_caveats: software renderer supervision cannot establish physical-amplifier fidelity or promote a checkpoint
only the source-authored no-cabinet Amp algorithm is used; demo audio, cabinet code/assets, Audio Units and third-party plugins are excluded
the source comments describe tuning against commercial reference rigs, so this source is an architecture/control prior rather than independent physical validation
selection must return to product-authorized physical Marshall and profile-disjoint EGDB evidence, with human listening still required

sources.title: GOAT: A Large Dataset of Paired Guitar Audio Recordings and Tablatures
sources.pairing: 5.9 hours of electric-guitar DI with five amp/cab-rendered variants totaling 29.5 hours, according to the official project description
sources.control_labels: render configuration metadata is described by the project but inaccessible without a granted dataset request
audio_quality_caveats: the official Zenodo dataset record is restricted-access and CC-BY-NC-4.0
the record explicitly says the dataset is for research purposes only and is not intended for use in any commercial product
the CC-BY-4.0 notice on the paper applies to the paper and does not override the dataset record

sources.title: ToneTwist AFx Dataset: Audacity Effect Chain - Compression, Distortion, Reverb
sources.pairing: one fixed Audacity Compressor, Distortion and Reverb software chain over marker-aligned dry material
sources.control_labels: fixed published Audacity controls and published effect order
audio_quality_caveats: the official deposit is CC-BY-4.0, but the listed dry material mixes IDMT, NAM, private and YouTube-derived sources whose product rights are not established as one uniform grant
the effect chain is Audacity software, not a physical multi-effect hardware chain
most dry sources were peak-normalized and multiplied by a new random gain every five seconds
the fixed compressor ratio is outside the currently packaged generic Dynamics domain and the Reverb expert remains unresolved
do not download for physical veto, restoration gradients, calibration, selection or listening acceptance
